documentation.content: The shared ila-pg database has had more than 20 connections for 5 minutes. Its limit is 25, and when it is reached every catalog page and batch fails. First check whether a load test, an eval job or many batches are running at once and stop the extra work. Then compare the worker, web and job sizes in infra/deploy.sh with docs/solutions/db-connection-budget.md.
